complete_examples.text: However, the time-frequency unification method is capable of dividing the frequency components into multi-scale frequency ranges to reduce the cross interferences.

To validate the reliability of the time-frequency unification method (TFUM) presented in Sections 2 and 4, an extended application in identifying and locating rail geometric waveforms will be illustrated as supplementary validations.
